question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence.**

The pandemic deeply affected small business owners, as __they have no means of livelihood left__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Pauper**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct word that means the same as the group of words underlined in the given sentence is: **Pauper**.
 
• Explanation:
 
 
• **Pauper** (गरीब) - a very poor person who depends on charity or public support.
 
• **Worker** (कर्मचारी) - a person who performs tasks, especially physical or manual labor.
 
• **Unemployed** (बेरोजगार) - not currently working and actively seeking employment.
 
• **Mason** (मिस्त्री) - a person who works with stone, brick, or concrete to build walls, buildings, and other structures. 
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1) Pauper.**
